plan.notes: SOURCE: Official Caldwell University 'Major: Computer Science — School of Business and Computer Science — Suggested Four-Year Major Plan (Academic Year 2022-2023)' PDF, https://my.caldwell.edu/ICS/icsfs/Computer_Science_22-23_V.2_(1).pdf?target=a7c18eb0-fbd5-48d3-8cfe-a28655ce6633 (August 2022 revision). True degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (printed on the plan's own footer and course-audit sheet). Transcription method: manual transcription from the official PDF text, verified against the plan's printed term totals. CREDIT TOTALS: the sequence's own printed term totals (17+15+15+15+15+15+15+13) sum to exactly 120, which matches the catalog's published minimum (Total Credits Required (minimum): 120 credits). No discrepancy. PLACEMENT CAVEAT: students must pass the CS 115 waiver test to enroll in CS 195; students who do not pass must take CS 115 (Essential Computer Skills) before beginning the major sequence — modeled as CS 195 prereq [] with this caveat here rather than as a prereq code. A second writing-intensive (WI) course is required before the end of the fourth semester (waived for transfers with 30+ credits). PREREQ SOURCES: from the plan's own course-audit table — CS 196 req CS 195; CS 216 req CS 196; CS 302 req CS 216; MA 311 req MA 140; CS 322 req CS 196; CS 450 req Senior Status AND (CS 322 or CS 348 or CS 355). CS 348/CS 355 are not part of this major's plan, so CS 450's prereq is modeled as ["CS 322"] with the either/or documented here; 'Senior Status' is a standing requirement, not a course code. The 10 CS 200-level-or-above electives note 'check courses individually for prerequisites'. Major rules on plan: 10 additional 3-credit CS courses at the 200 level or above; minimum grade C in major courses; overall GPA 2.0. Enriched Core = one course from each of three clusters (Ethical Inquiry / Global Awareness / Catholic & Dominican). The 'Electives' rows carry the catalog footnote 'Remaining credits are determined based on meeting the minimum graduation credits in consultation with the student's Academic Advisor.' BU 205 and MA 140 are counted as part of the liberal arts/science core per the plan's footnote.
